# Sanitized final-checkout fixtures

These files are synthetic, offline-only contract examples. They contain no capture,
cookie, token, account, address, card, or production checkout identifier. No public
asset research or authenticated request was performed for this fixture-only adapter.

The adapter deliberately models only the caller-supplied expected route family:
`POST /v3/checkouts/order/1` and a checkout-ID-scoped read-only `GET`. It has no
completion mutation because no complete public contract evidence was retained.
